'''Korman Lao''' was the leader of a group of fanatics known as the [[Kanzer Exiles]],<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> who originated from the [[Valtaullu Rift/Legends|Valtaullu Rift]]<ref name="BS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="SM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> Lao’s followers called the leader the [[Lord Ravager]]<ref name="SM" /> and were endlessly devoted to this figure,<ref name="BS" /> to the point that the devotees even erected a [[Temple of Korman Lao|temple]] the size of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in honor of Lao.<ref name="SM" />
